title: megalastrum lanuginosum
intro: Megalastrum lanuginosum, commonly known as the woolly megalastrum, is a plant species of the family Ophioglossaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, which include promoting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Megalastrum lanuginosum include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Research has identified the presence of these compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in treating various health conditions.
